objective: Test whether the causal coarse spectral-crowding observer and its newly exposed pairwise evidence remain internally consistent and musically useful across immutable real Genesis and SPC playback before any pair-aware renderer control is introduced.

runtime_inputs_may_include: shared-effect-return identity where the source family establishes it
past-only realtime observer and mix-budget state
control_boundary.outer_experiment_routing: Corpus IDs and source-family labels may select immutable fixtures and choose the correct decoder/runtime frontend, but they may not alter crowding measurements, thresholds, pair eligibility, budgets, or Omniphony presentation decisions. Rows should use immutable object SHA-256 as the primary fixture identity so titles can be joined only after measurement.

hard_admission_rules: A recorded block must come from a process call with learned=true and governor_trace_index!=0.
validate_realtime_spatial_governor_trace(trace) must return valid=true for every admitted block.
Within one uninterrupted fixture timeline, validate_realtime_spatial_governor_trace_continuity(previous,current) must return valid=true for every adjacent admitted pair.
The exact ABI 0.4 renderer budget must equal the transport projection of the compiler budget applied to that block.
The applied budget of block n+1 must equal the learned budget of block n within the frozen validator tolerance.
The lazy pair field must reconstruct the existing scene coarse_spectral_overlap within the frozen validator tolerance.
Only active dry-source lanes may form spectral-overlap pairs. Shared effect returns remain scene wet-occupancy evidence and are never dry masking pairs.
A decoder seek, track change, or restart begins a new trace timeline; its first successful trace index must be 1 and is not checked for continuity against the previous timeline.
diagnostic_metrics: frequency and magnitude of learned dry-width/diffuse contraction
frequency and magnitude of learned shared-wet contraction
frequency and magnitude of learned externalization contraction
Genesis versus SPC distributions reported separately before any pooled summary
falsifiers: Any admitted shared-effect-return pair is a contract failure.
Any per-block scalar/pair reconstruction mismatch beyond tolerance is a contract failure.
Any adjacent-block applied-budget/prior-learned-budget mismatch beyond tolerance is a causality failure.
Any compiler-applied/renderer-ABI budget mismatch beyond tolerance is a transport failure.
Any duplicate or stale trace accepted after a failed process call is a transaction-identity failure.
If real dry-source pair overlaps show no meaningful within-scene variation, pair-aware separation is not justified by this three-band representation.

If pair behavior differs strongly by source family in a way explained by transport artifacts rather than measured source spectra, pair-aware separation is not admitted until that artifact is resolved.
Listening preference alone cannot rescue a failed evidence or causality rule.
promotion_rule: Do not add a pair-aware Omniphony separation-pressure control from this preregistration alone. Promotion requires admitted real-corpus traces, a non-degenerate pairwise signal, preserved source-native routing semantics, and a separate renderer-side control contract that cannot rewrite authored pan or claim invented source coordinates.
current_execution_note: The conversational GitHub connector exposes the committed binary corpus but truncates binary payloads before they can be reconstructed in the local execution runtime. No real-corpus numerical result is claimed by this preregistration.
